module: Flowgraph node "Get Timer". Reads the state of a timer (timerId). Outputs: flow, complete, completed (single pulse), incomplete, elapsed, remaining, duration, elapsedPercent (0 to 1). If capTime is true, elapsed/remaining/elapsedPercent are clamped once the timer is complete. Input reset: resets the completion detection.
notes: elapsedPercent divides by the duration: a duration of 0 gives inf/NaN.

_executionStarted.desc: Called when the flowgraph project execution starts; resets the node's internal state.

work.desc: If the timer exists, fills the outputs and fires completed only once at the end; otherwise flow stays false.
